unpaywall.workflow: Normalized DOI GET requests using the configured Unpaywall contact, followed by the actual returned public PDF or landing location. The configured contact and API query URLs are not retained.
unpaywall.technical_fallback: The initial local requests-module attempt could not run because requests was unavailable; standard-library urllib was used successfully. This was a technical dependency fallback, not an access-control bypass.
unpaywall.interpretation: OA status/version/license describes access metadata. It does not validate efficacy, confer therapeutic commercial rights, or make two versions independent studies. CuNC best url_for_pdf is null, so its landing page was followed. Nifuroxazide best license is null and remains null. The GBT preprint metadata acceptedVersion label does not convert it into a separate peer-reviewed study.

quality_boundaries: Primary text/captions, not parser-generated approximate figure tables, govern reported endpoint counts and results.
No exhaustive supplemental-panel/raw-data audit is claimed. Independent root reading of the same papers is analytical checking, not independent scientific replication.
PSB human fusion is not human force; FD repeated readings are not animals; CuNC day-50 boundary is not established median lifespan.
Paper versions and patent examples remain within their investigator lineages unless overlap is resolved.
No missing patent hit or ceased WO index entry was converted into FTO. No available license, quote or live supplier stock was invented.
No third-party full-text payload or biological operational procedure is included in the committed artifacts.
stopping_boundary: Three retained exact-use records and three fully read rejected/partnered scouts are sufficient for the supported decision. Named public-record gates may be resolved or closed; no extra family is added to meet a quota.
